targets.adjudication_verdict: GENUINE, INFORMATIVE FAIL -- the self-route label is accurate. Exactly one load-bearing criterion failed, and it is the discrimination criterion (C2: mean probe Jaccard trained 0.667 vs required <= untrained 0.400 - 0.25 = 0.15). Its own readiness gate was met (headroom 0.400 >= 0.25), precondition_unmet=false, non-degenerate, and the FAIL is noise-proof in the direction that matters: no trained seed reached Jaccard 0, min trained Jaccard 1/3, so the required -0.25 move is clearly absent. Everything else passed: P0 writepath (min 1432 writes vs 200), C1 occupancy 5/5 in both gumbel arms (16/16 slots -- Gumbel-noise-driven, training-independent, as pre-registered), LEGACY reproduced the known 3-seed single-slot lock (seeds 7/13/100, the 436e/436f/943 operating point), both mechanical controls clean, and the entropy comparison is arm-matched (identical per-seed write counts -> identical tau anneal; the untrained arm's 3.97 entropy shows annealing alone does not concentrate). STRENGTH CALIBRATION (red-team finding): the WRONG-DIRECTION reading (+0.267 mean move, trained more collapsed) is SUGGESTIVE, not established -- by exact paired sign-flip / permutation on 5 bimodal per-seed Jaccards it is p ~ 0.24-0.28 (3 seeds up, 2 down), and the corroborating 40-episode pre-check (0.4 -> 0.9, same direction) is non-independent and non-load-bearing. So the robust conclusion is 'training the pairwise-diversity loss at w=0.5 did NOT produce content discrimination'; 'training actively worsens it' remains a live-but-unproven reading (its cheap confirmer: +10 seeds x 2 gumbel arms, ~26 min cloud, and/or probe_clusters > 2). Training DID concentrate training-time writes (entropy 3.97 -> 2.67-3.24; self-repeat 0.06 -> 0.35-0.51) and moved the tagger substantially (1.14-1.37) -- the tagger learns SOMETHING; whether that something is anti-discriminative or merely non-discriminative is exactly what the follow-on portfolio should separate.

live_hypotheses: H1 loss-objective-mismatch: pairwise addressing-distribution diversity does not reference content similarity at all, so optimizing it need not (and at this operating point did not) produce content conditioning -- a content-referencing objective (e.g. contrastive: same-cluster states to same slots, cross-cluster to different) is required. Direct precedent: V3-EXQ-907's confirmed read-path result, where a context-referencing objective broke the saddle at the same 15,000-step schedule

H2 operating-point: weight 0.5 / 100-episode schedule is the wrong operating point for this loss (only value ever measured); some weight/anneal/duration yields discrimination -- NOT eliminated by this run (the wrong-direction move is p~0.25 at n=5, so 'longer/heavier training helps' remains live)

H3 task-pressure-required: no write-side auxiliary loss suffices -- content-conditioned addressing only emerges when the READ path's task gradient flows back through write selection (end-to-end pressure), i.e. the frame 'train the tagger with a standalone auxiliary loss' is wrong

H4 input-distribution: train-time z_world under-differentiation (the SD-008 ~0.98-cosine cone) leaves the tagger with no usable content structure DURING training, so no write-side objective can learn content conditioning from real-agent latents regardless of its form -- un-instrumented in this manifest (no train-time latent-differentiation readout), and a synthetic-stream probe of H1 would conflate objective with input distribution unless it also trains on the synthetic stream

suggested_probes.sketch: swap in a content-referencing loss (contrastive/cluster-supervised) at the same schedule; to avoid conflating with H4, run it both on real-agent latents and on the synthetic 2-cluster stream as training input; null: Jaccard does not drop by the margin in either regime

cheap seed/weight sweep first (+10 seeds x 2 gumbel arms ~26 min cloud settles the wrong-direction question; then weights {0.1, 2.0, 8.0} at moderate scale); null: no operating point moves Jaccard in the correct direction
couple SD-016 read-path retrieval loss through write selection (straight-through) so task pressure reaches the tagger; null: coupled training still fails the margin

instrument train-time content structure: record pairwise cosine distribution / cluster separability of the actual write-stream latents during training alongside the tagger's selection; null: latents carry separable structure the tagger ignores (which would refocus on H1/H3)

learning_extracted: 'The tagger trains' and 'the tagger learns the right thing' are separate questions: the tagger moved substantially (1.14-1.37) and concentrated writes while content discrimination did not improve (and the point estimate worsened, p~0.25 at n=5) -- a diversity-shaped auxiliary loss does not reference content and so does not purchase content conditioning.

The driver's _e1_tick wiring fix (without which compute_prediction_loss returned exactly 0.0 on every step and the tagger stayed byte-frozen) is the load-bearing methodological find: any prior driver in this family that skipped act()/act_with_split_obs() silently trained NOTHING through compute_prediction_loss. The mechanical positive/negative controls (tagger moved vs byte-frozen) are what made this run's wiring trustworthy and should be standard for any auxiliary-loss validation.

Two independent loss designs (MoE importance; pairwise diversity) have now failed content-discrimination for write addressing -- the recurrence points FIRST at the objective family (H1: neither references content), though the operating point (H2) and input-distribution (H4) hypotheses are not eliminated by this run.
